laura_ops: Hey @titan_rep — we just got a late notice: PO# 8274-NEEDLE, 40x H100s delayed. Vendor email says customs hold at AMS, possible HS code mismatch. Can you confirm status and ETA? 

 t itan_rep: Sorry — confirmed hold. Carrier flagged HS 8471.80 vs 8542.39, need clarification from vendor. AWB 123-4567890. ETA if cleared by customs: 5–7 business days. If we request air expediting, we can move 8–12 units in 48–72h but cost +15% per unit. 

 kevin_proc: Oof. Can we get official quote for the +15% uplift? Also what's the lead time impact if we split shipment? 

 maria_logistics: Depot readiness: we have space for 12 units immediate. Need RMA labels for DOA workflow if any arrive damaged. Also confirm serial manifest format — last time vendor sent mixed SKUs. 

 josh_infra: Heads up — we're at 92% of reserve pool in us-west-2. If these 40 are delayed, some queued jobs will push to other regions. What's the cost delta for moving capacity? @ana_ops_manager ⬆️ 

 titan_rep: Quote attached in carrier thread (link): https://carrier.example.com/quote/8274 — uplift 15% air, handling fee €120/unit for customs rework. If we split: air 12 units now, sea remainder ETA 18–21 days. We can also reclassify HS if Redwood provides declaration; need importer of record to sign. 

 laura_ops: Can you paste AWB and manifest here? We need to loop legal/KYC for IOR signature. 

 titan_rep: AWB: 123-4567890. Manifest snippet:
```
SKU,H100-48GB
Serials: SN1001,SN1002...SN1040
Declared value: 160k EUR
HS: 8471.80 (vendor) -> carrier flagged 8542.39
```

 rma_bot: RMA ticket created #RMA-5501 for potential DOA checks if any H100s arrive damaged. Assigned to maria_logistics. 

 kevin_proc: Given impact, approve split: expedite 10 units air (finance will absorb 15% uplift), remainder by sea. Get signed IOR if reclassifying HS before customs release. Need written confirmation by EOD. 

 ana_ops_manager: Agreed. Titan — proceed with air for 10 units, generate proforma with uplift and AWB amendments. Send manifest with clear SKU/serial mapping to avoid depot sorting delays. 

 titan_rep: Understood. I'll get revised proforma and updated AWB within 2 hours. Will also request carrier to mark 'sort-friendly' to reduce depot handling time. 

 laura_ops: Thanks. Maria — hold space for 10 incoming, prep RMA bench and spare PSU kits. Josh — I'll flag migrations to us-east as temporary. We'll reconvene if anything changes. :thumbsup:
